title: AGENTS.md
text: Three source files: R/penalized.R (core penalized_est(), objective/gradient assembly, telescoping), R/multistart.R (random_start(), penalized_est_multistart()), R/alf.R (penalties l0a/alf + gradients, composite_pair_loss()). Canonical usage pattern: fit dry-run lavaan model .fit = FALSE → parTable() → take free column values pen_par_id / pen_diff_id entries → penalized_est(). IDs positions free-parameter vector (matching lavaan::coef() order), parTable row numbers — common --design mistake. pen_diff_id named list matrices: one row per group/time point, one column per matched parameter. penalty sum pairwise row differences, rescaled (nrow - 1)/ncombn. Structural NAs matrices mean “parameter absent row” must preserved. returned lavaan object rebuilt .fit = FALSE (see make_penalized_fit(), R/penalized.R:352): summary() works SEs absent unless se = "robust.huber.white" (experimental sandwich approximation — interpret caution). eps = "telescoping" runs log-spaced sequence epsilons, reusing original start default (warm_start = TRUE chains starts); stops max |Δparam| ≤ 5e-4. penalized_est_multistart() sequential design; parallelism call penalized_est(start = ...) directly per start.
